findings.description: The error message text ("Invalid credentials") is invisible: the alert's text colour is the same as its pale red background (--danger-bg on --danger-bg), so a failed sign-in shows an empty pink box. Sighted users get no readable feedback (also fails contrast).
repro: Enter a wrong username and password and submit
Observe the red-bordered alert box is empty-looking; selecting it reveals the text is there

findings.description: Keyboard focus indicator is removed globally (`*:focus, *:focus-visible { outline: none }`) with no replacement style. Tabbing through links, buttons (Edit, Delete, Apply, Sign out) and form fields shows no visible focus, so keyboard users cannot tell where they are.
repro: Observe no visible focus ring or other indicator on the focused element (computed outline-style none, box-shadow none)

notes: Checked 1280 and 360 widths for viewer and editor: no horizontal overflow, totals correct (399.99, filter 185.25), viewer gets 403 on edit/new/delete. Not tested: touch-specific behaviour, screen reader output.

cost.notes: estimate from 25567 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0051-$0.0614
